heroBody: The Dyson V15 Detect is Dyson's flagship cordless stick vacuum, and Singapore pricing has been stubbornly close to the MSRP since launch — except during the deeper Shopee and Lazada sale periods, on the Dyson outlet store, and on parallel‑import listings. Authorised retailers like Dyson.sg, Harvey Norman and Best Denki hold the official line, while Amazon.sg, Shopee Mall and LazMall stores undercut meaningfully when vouchers and cashback stack. This page pulls live Singapore listings from BuyWhere's catalog every few minutes so you can see the current floor price, who is offering it, and whether the cheapest listing is a local set with Dyson Singapore warranty or a parallel import with shop warranty only.

highlightSectionTitle: What to know before you buy a Dyson V15 in Singapore

highlights.title: Detect vs older V15 models
highlights.body: The current 'V15 Detect' ships with the laser‑illuminated cleaner head that makes dust visible on hard floors. Earlier V15 Animal / V15 Absolute stock still surfaces at outlet prices, but those kits ship without the laser head and are usually a worse buy at any small price gap.

highlights.title: Refurbished stock from Dyson
highlights.body: Dyson.sg lists 'Certified Refurbished' V15 Detect units for a meaningful discount off the MSRP with the same 2-year warranty as new. This is the best value play if you do not need an unopened box — third‑party 'open box' listings on Carousell are a different story with much shorter warranty coverage.

highlights.title: Bundles vs bare unit
highlights.body: Retailers often bundle the V15 with extra batteries, a wall dock or the hair screw tool. If the bundle price is only modestly above the bare unit and you actually want the accessory, take the bundle; if it is meaningfully over and you do not need the extras, skip it — bare units are heavily stocked.

adviceSectionTitle: How to pay the least without getting burned
advicePoints: Time it: Dyson.sg rarely discounts outside Black Friday equivalents and a mid‑year promo. Shopee and Lazada official stores discount deepest on 9.9, 10.10, 11.11, 12.12 and mid‑month payday campaigns; Amazon.sg tends to match within days.

Prefer Dyson Certified Refurbished over third‑party 'Open Box' listings from unknown sellers: same 2-year Dyson Singapore warranty, materially cheaper, and Dyson ships the new sealed packaging directly.
Check whether the listing says 'local set' or 'Dyson Singapore warranty'. Parallel imports are cheaper but Dyson Singapore will not service them under warranty.
Stack vouchers before you compare: a higher sticker price with a platform coupon and cashback often beats the lowest raw listing.
Ignore listings well under the market floor with no reviews — they are usually pre‑orders, refurbished units sold as new or bait‑and‑switch.
faqSectionTitle: Dyson V15 in Singapore — common questions

faqs.question: Is the Dyson V15 worth it over the V12 in Singapore?
faqs.answer: If you have a mostly hard‑floor home with pets, the laser head and stronger suction justify the upgrade. If your home is mostly carpet and you already own a V12, the V15 is a smaller jump and a discounted V12 is the smarter buy.

faqs.question: Do parallel‑import Dyson V15 sets come with warranty in Singapore?
faqs.answer: No. Dyson Singapore honours warranty for local sets only. Parallel‑import listings carry the shop's own warranty, which is why they are cheaper.

faqs.question: When is the Dyson V15 cheapest in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Historically during platform sale days (9.9, 11.11, 12.12) and payday campaigns on Shopee and Lazada, with Amazon.sg matching within days. Outside those windows the live prices on this page show the current floor.

faqs.question: Is the Dyson V15 worth buying refurbished in Singapore?
faqs.answer: Dyson.sg Certified Refurbished units ship with the same 2‑year Singapore warranty as new and are a reliable way to save. Third‑party refurbished listings from unknown sellers carry much shorter warranties and are not worth the small extra discount.
